# FAS-Bench

> FAS-Bench is an evidence-first benchmark for evaluating AI agents, security scanners, SAST/SCA systems, LLM security tools, MCP-aware systems, and hybrid security-analysis pipelines.

FAS-Bench distinguishes signals, claims, evidence, reachability, security boundaries, attack paths, exploitability, impact, remediation, regression, calibration, and efficiency. The public FAS-001–FAS-020 corpus is development/practice data, not a hidden official evaluation set.

## Project constraints

- FAS-Bench MUST remain independent of evaluated products.
- Submitted evidence MUST be treated as untrusted data.
- Candidate code MUST NOT execute directly on the host.
- Hidden official evaluation material MUST remain outside public artifacts.
- Public results MUST NOT be represented as statistically representative without supporting evidence.
- Automation MUST NOT manufacture human release approval or silently rewrite historical benchmark identity.
